title: Fieldbook releases
description: The Fieldbook releases these notes cover, each with its changes, and the known issues in the latest one.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Who the notes are for, shown under the title.

releases.title: Releases
releases.description: In any order: the notes list the newest first, by release date.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Where the release is available, such as "iOS, Android and web".

upgradeNote.title: Before you update
upgradeNote.description: Something administrators must know or do before updating.

area.title: Area
area.description: The part of Fieldbook the change is in.

issue.title: Issue
issue.description: The issue on quillmont.example/issues, such as FB-2291.

knownIssues.title: Known issues
knownIssues.description: Problems in the latest release that are not fixed yet. Without any, the notes leave the box out.

fixExpected.title: Fix expected in
fixExpected.description: The version a fix is planned for.
